title: The Wild Boar and the Fox

full_text:
A wild boar stood beneath an oak tree, busily sharpening his tusks against the rough bark. A fox strolling past asked why he was whetting his weapons when neither hunter nor hound was anywhere in sight.

The boar paused, wiped his brow, and replied: "When danger strikes, I will have no time to sharpen my tusks; I must have them ready for combat before the enemy arrives!"
moral: Preparedness in peace ensures safety in war; hone your weapons before the battle.
